title: Hofheimer Straße, Frankfurt am Main
description:
The apartment is ideal for people who want to spend a few months in a fully equipped apartment with family or receive family / visitors or people who always need to stay temporarily near the airport / Frankfurt / ISF International School Frankfurt Rhein-Main. Gladly also up to four individuals in flat share (WG) structure.

The bright, fully renovated and furnished maisonette apartment is located on the second floor. The rooms are distributed on 2 floors. The apartment has a large bedroom with double bed downstairs and a second bedroom/living room upstairs. In the upper bedroom/living room, if necessary, a second bed can be placed. There is a daylight shower bathroom downstairs and a daylight bathtub bathroom upstairs. The living room is maisonette style and has a spacious gallery upstairs. The balcony invites you to relax and enjoy the sun. In addition to a car parking space, a fitted kitchen with Miele appliances, among others, belongs to the apartment. The rental period is flexible. The price also includes a 14-day cleaning of the apartment excluding the two bedrooms. 
Equipment
The apartment is fully equipped, including dinnerware , kitchen utensils, towels, bedding, bed linen, etc., has very high quality herringbone parquet flooring and tiles in the bathrooms, kitchen and hallway.

Maisonette living room: dining table with 5 chairs, seating area, TV, reading corner with stereo, high quality folding shutters.

Gallery: bistro seating area, large desk

Fitted kitchen: dishwasher by Miele, microwave with grill, oven, hob, extractor hood

Bedroom: adjustable double bed by Hülsta, large built-in wardrobe by Cabinet, pleated shutters

Living room/bedroom: bed and wardrobes by Hülsta, two armchairs by Molteni, TV; second bed possible if required

Daylight bathrooms: shower, bathtub, mirrored cabinets, wall cabinets 

Balcony: south side, bistro table with two chairs, awning, balcony light, balcony edging

Washing machine in the washing cellar, clothes horse, ironing board, one vacuum cleaner each upstairs and downstairs

In the furnished apartment everything is sufficiently available, so you only need to bring your personal belongings and nothing else.
Location
Frankfurt Zeilsheim.
Very conveniently located. Bus X53 and M55 run in the immediate vicinity and takes you to the train station Höchst or S-Bahn stop Zeilsheim or Sindlingen.  All stores for daily needs (supermarket, banks, hairdresser cleaning, etc.) can be reached on foot in about 10 minutes. By car you can get directly to the A66, which takes you to Frankfurt city center or the airport in about 15 min. or to Wiesbaden in about 20 min.
Other
From the bedroom/living room upstairs very nice Taunus view.

title: Friedrich-Ebert-Straße, Hattersheim am Main
description:
The property is located at Friedrich-Ebert-Straße 32 in Hattersheim am Main, a well-connected town in the Main-Taunus district between Frankfurt and Wiesbaden. The building itself is a 7–8 storey residential high-rise constructed in 1976, comprising 98 residential units. Features include a central heating system, lift, basement storage, garden area, and balconies. The building benefits from a caretaker/Hausmeister service.
Hattersheim am Main station is served by S-Bahn line S1 of the Rhine-Main S-Bahn network, providing direct connections to Frankfurt city centre, Frankfurt Central Station underground, and onward to Offenbach and Rödermark. Hattersheim has a central location within the Rhine-Main metropolitan area and is well connected both by car and public transport. Frankfurt Airport is approximately 15 minutes by car.
Friedrich-Ebert-Straße is a residential street with pavements on both sides, a 30 km/h speed limit, and asphalt surface. Local shops, supermarkets, and everyday amenities are within walking distance of the property. The A3/A66 motorway connections provide excellent road access to Frankfurt and Wiesbaden.

Die Immobilie befindet sich in der Friedrich-Ebert-Straße 32 in Hattersheim am Main, einer gut angebundenen Stadt im Main-Taunus-Kreis zwischen Frankfurt und Wiesbaden. Das Gebäude ist ein 7–8-stöckiges Wohnhochhaus aus dem Jahr 1976 mit insgesamt 98 Wohneinheiten. Zur Ausstattung gehören Zentralheizung, Aufzug, Kellerabteile, Gartenanlage sowie Balkone. Ein Hausmeisterservice ist vorhanden.
Der S-Bahnhof Hattersheim (Main) liegt in unmittelbarer Nähe und wird von der Linie S1 des Rhein-Main-S-Bahn-Netzes bedient, mit Direktverbindungen in die Frankfurter Innenstadt, zum Hauptbahnhof sowie weiter nach Offenbach und Rödermark. Der Frankfurter Flughafen ist mit dem Auto in ca. 15 Minuten erreichbar.
Die Friedrich-Ebert-Straße ist eine Wohnstraße mit Gehwegen auf beiden Seiten, einer Höchstgeschwindigkeit von 30 km/h und Asphaltbelag. Einkaufsmöglichkeiten und Alltagsversorgung sind fußläufig erreichbar. Über die nahe gelegenen Autobahnanschlüsse A3 und A66 bestehen hervorragende Straßenverbindungen nach Frankfurt und Wiesbaden.
